title: MIT Students Built a Jet Engine with AI in 4 Weeks
description:
MIT students built a working single-spool jet engine in four weeks with AI as the main engineer. Claude and Grok handled most of the design and simulation while the team focused on manufacturing.

The engine fired successfully. It shows how AI can take on the heavy math and physics work in hardware projects.
